variance_decomposition.note: Two-way ANOVA on cell means over seeds; interaction is the residual. Bootstrap resamples seeds within each cell. trained3 = ridge/xgboost/randomforest; all4 adds mlp, which loses to the training mean in 7 of 10 dataset x protocol cells and would otherwise be invisible.

docking_paired.note: Pairing is identical to 06: same test pair_ids, same Vina regression fit on the train block, same seed-0 model predictions. Both deltas are oriented so positive favours the model: delta_rmse = RMSE_vina - RMSE_model and delta_ci = CI_model - CI_vina. Row bootstrap resamples pairs; cluster bootstrap resamples kinase targets because pairs inside a target are dependent.

testset_bootstrap.sign_test_caveat: exact sign tests treat test rows as exchangeable and therefore ignore within-target / within-ligand correlation; they are anti-conservative relative to the cluster bootstraps and are reported alongside, not instead of, them
